summary: Voters in Moradabad Dehat complain most about broken roads, potholes, choked drains and waterlogging, and a garbage heap at Nawabpura chauraha, with farmers adding fertiliser shortage and rising prices; the positives are thin in the sources found.

positives.english: *Government ration and pension schemes help some families here
positives.hindi: *सरकारी राशन और पेंशन योजना से कुछ परिवारों को मदद मिलती है
positives.basis: Inference: no AC-specific report of a delivered scheme benefit was found in the sources searched. The Amar Ujala Moradabad Dehat report (28 Aug 2026) does not mention ration or pension schemes.

positives.english: Some farmers say the MLA visits, and in their view the work is right
positives.hindi: कुछ किसान कहते हैं, विधायक आते हैं, उनकी नजर में काम सही है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala report on Moradabad Dehat (28 Aug 2026): some farmers said the MLA visits and that in their view the work is correct ("विधायक आते हैं और उनकी नजर में काम सही है"). No project, road or village is named, so this is a weak, opinion-level positive.

positives.english: *Farmers get some help from government procurement and the support price
positives.hindi: *किसानों को सरकारी खरीद और समर्थन मूल्य से कुछ सहारा मिलता है
positives.basis: Inference: no Moradabad Dehat-specific report on procurement benefits was found. Farmers in the seat raised fertiliser and price problems in the Amar Ujala report (28 Aug 2026), so this is not confirmed as a positive.

positives.english: *In some villages, fields get irrigated from the canal and tubewells
positives.hindi: *कुछ गांवों में नहर और नलकूप से खेत की सिंचाई हो जाती है
positives.basis: Inference: no AC-specific source confirming canal or tubewell irrigation coverage was fetched. A June 2026 Amar Ujala snippet (Thakurdwara dateline, not fetched) mentions private tubewells, but it is not a government benefit and is not confirmed for this AC.

positives.english: *In some places, drinking water is available from handpumps and tanks
positives.hindi: *कुछ जगहों पर हैंडपंप और टंकी से पीने का पानी मिल जाता है
positives.basis: Inference: no AC-specific source on water supply coverage was found. Other Moradabad reports seen in search describe water not reaching homes in city localities, so this positive is weak and unconfirmed.

negatives.english: We are troubled by the fertiliser shortage and rising prices
negatives.hindi: हमें खाद की कमी और बढ़ती महंगाई से परेशानी है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala report on Moradabad Dehat (28 Aug 2026): farmers named fertiliser shortage (खाद की उपलब्धता) and rising prices as their main concerns ("खाद की कमी और बढ़ती महंगाई उनके मुख्य मुद्दे हैं"). Seat-level, not a single village. Lived-experience content only.

negatives.english: In Chakkar ki Milak our road has become dilapidated, with potholes
negatives.hindi: चक्कर की मिलक में हमारी सड़क जर्जर हो चुकी है, गड्ढे पड़े हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (13 Feb 2026): Ward 25, Chakkar ki Milak; a road built about a year earlier was dug up for sewer work and left with potholes and a broken surface. AC membership unconfirmed: the article names no vidhan sabha. Jan 2025 report: MLA Nasir Qureshi (Moradabad Dehat) raised the dilapidated road at Chakkar ki Milak in the Nagar Nigam board meeting as a problem of his assembly constituency.

negatives.english: There are potholes on Balaji Mandir Road
negatives.hindi: बालाजी मंदिर रोड पर गड्ढे हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (9 Jan 2025): MLA Nasir Qureshi raised potholes on Balaji Mandir Road at the Nagar Nigam board meeting, described as problems of his assembly constituency. AC membership rests on the MLA's statement; no independent source found. Article is about 21 months old; current state not confirmed.

negatives.english: The Jhabbu ka Nala drain is choked
negatives.hindi: झब्बू का नाला चोक पड़ा है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (9 Jan 2025): MLA Nasir Qureshi raised the choked Jhabbu ka Nala at the Nagar Nigam board meeting, described as problems of his assembly constituency. AC membership rests on the MLA's statement; no independent source found. No later update in the sources found.

negatives.english: A garbage heap has lain at Nawabpura chauraha for years
negatives.hindi: नवाबपुरा चौराहे पर सालों से कूड़े का ढेर पड़ा है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (9 Jan 2025): MLA Nasir Qureshi raised the garbage heap at Nawabpura chauraha, described as lying there for years, at the Nagar Nigam board meeting. AC membership rests on the MLA's statement; no independent source found. Current state not confirmed.

notes: AC identity confirmed from Wikipedia (No. 27, Moradabad Rural, Moradabad district, reserved: None). AC extent NOT confirmed: Wikipedia names no tehsils or villages for AC 27; Moradabad Nagar (AC 28) Wikipedia page has no extent section; moradabad.nic.in constituency page returned 503 and could not be read. Independent check of the four city localities: Chakkar ki Milak is Nagar Nigam ward 25 (Amar Ujala 13 Feb 2026), but that article names no vidhan sabha, and a Nagar Nigam ward does not establish AC membership (AC 28 could cover the same city wards). Jhabbu ka Nala is in the Nagphani area (Amar Ujala Sept 2025 drain-rebuild story seen only as a search snippet, not fetched; it names no AC). No source found for Balaji Mandir Road or Nawabpura chauraha. The four city negatives therefore rest on the MLA's statement in the Jan 2025 report, which names the seat. Field check still needed. Positives: no AC-specific delivered benefit confirmed. Candidates not used: (a) Amar Ujala/Aaj Tak 9 Sep 2026, Didori and Mangupura villages in Moradabad, paved roads now built, no AC or block named (https://www.aajtak.in/uttar-pradesh/story/muradabad-didori-mangu-pura-villages-swachh-bharat-mission-sanitation-road-improvement-ntcpvp-utrath-rptc-2639748-2026-09-09), needs an AC check before use; (b) Saahas Samachar 28 Jun 2026 preview of CM's Moradabad visit: 12 projects worth Rs 21.88 crore in Moradabad Dehat, no project named, announcement only, not used. Searches for village road or project completion in Moradabad Dehat in Hindi and English returned nothing else. Aug 2026 report used only for lived-experience items (roads, potholes, waterlogging, fertiliser, prices, farmers' MLA remark); no electoral data used. Field check needed for all positives. Voice pass (Round 3): P2 kept only to what the basis says (some farmers say the MLA visits and the work is right; no project named). P2 weak positive: opinion only, one report. P1 and P3 to P5 stay inference. N1, N2, N3, N5 reworded spoken; N4 unchanged.
